title: Evolving Spiking Lineage Cards
summary: Sort cautious paper cards for the active eSNN bundle into lineage, application, method-placeholder, and adaptive-structure roles without overclaiming unreviewed algorithm details.
learning_goals: Separate reviewed eSNN lineage context from pending exact growth-rule details.
Connect Schliebs2013, Wysoski2010, Kasabov2013, and Wang2014 to the thesis taxonomy without duplicating Roy2017 prematurely.
Use bundle readiness notes to decide which claims are safe for public teaching artifacts.
